newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy '96 PSBR to overshoot 130 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy '96 PSBR to overshoot 130 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's 1996 public deficit looks like overshooting 130 trillion lire due to seasonal and accounting factors in November and December, Credito Italiano bank analysts said in a research report.
Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said last week that PSBR for this year was worse than expected and was in line with 1995's 130 trillion lire.

The government had originally forecast 1996 PSBR of 113 trillion lire but Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio warned last month that the deficit might overshoot the 113 trillion lire target by up to 20 trillion lire.

Credito Italiano said it forecast a 1996 deficit of around 136 to 138 trillion lire, revising upwards its estimate for a November deficit to 21 trillion lire, against 16.5 trillion it previously forecast.
Italy's cumulative public sector borrowing requirement for the first 10 months of this year was 116.3 trillion lire compared with around 116.6 trillion in the same period last year.
Credito said it would be difficult if not impossible to see an improvement in the December figure so as to keep the deficit under 130 trillion lire.
